title: land waits for a code item's merge when its code branch is gone right after the push because the merge request already merged
goal: When land pushes a code item's code/ID branch and the fetch right after it finds no such ref, land reads origin/main for the merge of that branch and, finding it, goes on to the second pass (rebase, done --commit, sync --push) in the same run instead of stopping with no tip to wait for; it stops only when neither the branch nor its merge is there.

run: import sys; t=open("_tools/bl_land.py",encoding="utf-8").read(); sys.exit("land still stops with no tip to wait for when the merged branch is gone" if "no tip to wait for" in t else 0)

notes: SP-lmpjclxz close: ST-xl4w2pmg and ST-nloqr64j each stopped right after the push of code/ID with 'could not fetch code/ID from origin after the push (fatal: couldn't find remote ref ...): no tip to wait for', while origin/main already held the Merge branch commit; each needed a second land run. The check reads the stop message's text, which the fix removes or makes conditional; the planner may replace it by a fixture that drives land with a local bare origin. Retro of the drain: the same stop on about 15 code-lane landings (merge requests 1810-1836): the merge request merges and deletes code/ID before land fetches it, so pushed_tip (bl_land.py) says 'could not fetch code/ID ... no tip to wait for' and returns None, the pass's pending stays empty, and land ends 'not done yet'; the orchestrator checks glab mr list --source-branch code/ID --all and runs land again. This item is the finding's own cause, so no new item is filed. The related drafts do not cover it: ST-oif6o3o6 starts its second pass from a recorded pending, which this stop never records; ST-igkt3vsr is the landing-lock wait, ST-yh5ivly4 a request stuck preparing, ST-ep7loyre a stop with no line. Priority raised from P3: a second land pass on every code-lane landing. The text check is a placeholder: replace it with a planted run of pushed_tip or land on a local bare origin whose main holds the merge of code/ID and has no code/ID.
